name: Tibet ASγ
full_name: Tibet Air Shower Array / ASγ Experiment
summary: Chinese–Japanese air-shower project whose diffuse ultrahigh-energy gamma-ray data have been used to constrain heavy dark-matter decay. This dossier distinguishes experimental observations from external theoretical reinterpretations.
detection_principle: A ground air-shower array and muon-background rejection identify high-energy gamma rays; diffuse spectra are compared with dark-matter decay models.

status.label: Current operational status not fully verified
status.evidence: A 2025 data reinterpretation exists, but it does not by itself establish the detector's operational status on that date.

collaboration.name: Tibet ASγ collaboration / mission team
collaboration.participants_note: Institutional participation refers to the period covered by each source; this dossier does not claim to provide a complete membership list.

results.summary: Research papers derive heavy-dark-matter lifetime constraints from published gamma-ray data.
Discussed jointly with LHAASO data for decaying dark matter at 10^6–10^9 GeV.

science_scope: Tests dark-matter models through astrophysical radiation, cosmic rays or neutrinos. Astrophysical backgrounds and propagation models affect interpretation; an anomaly alone does not establish dark matter.
